fact: The Global Findex 2025, from a face-to-face survey of 1,000 adults in Mali in July-August 2024 excluding Gao, Kidal, Mopti and Tombouctou, puts adults with an account at 55% and adults who made or received a digital payment at 52%.
title: The Global Findex Database 2025: Connectivity and Financial Inclusion in the Digital Economy
